messages:
jules: Heads up finance sent the nice email. We're at $99.9M ARR. One more final sprint and we hit triple digits. Quick celebration? :sparkles:
rafael: Yesss! I vote bento + sparkling tea in the kitchen at 3:30. Also can we paper-crown the scoreboard? :crown:
emma: I'll bring vegetarian bento boxes and napkins. also remote folks get a care package? @lucy pls advise. :bento:
lucy: remote care packs sound great. will coordinate with ops to ship stickers + mini snacks. ETA tomorrow. :package:
taro: tiny suggestion: 60-second 'thank you' mic where ppl shout out a teammate. i'm bringing a noise-making frog. :frog:
jules: 3:30 in the mezzanine. 60s mic, foam frog solo, then food. also quick pic for socials. :camera_with_flash:
confetti-bot: Reminder: sound check at 15:25; confetti cannon cleared. :boom:
rafael: poll: cake? bento? both? react with :cake: or :bento: or :balloon: for both
emma: remote folks 1212will be posted 10m before. i'll add cat cam in case someone's cat wants to participate. :cat:
lucy: shoutouts thread: tag someone and one sentence why they rocked this quarter.
taro: @emma for shipment heroics, @rafael for office logistics, @jules for closing the loop. also the infra crew for zero-latency miracles. :raised_hands:
jules: also special thanks to @ops-team, shipping these care packs fast. hug if you see them today. :hugs:
rafael: RSVP: in person. will bring frog, paper crowns, and extra chopsticks.
emma: RSVP: in person, veggie bentos, will post zoom link. sending remote care pack tracking.
lucy: RSVP: remote, will watch via cat cam. shipping stickers now.
confetti-bot: Post-event reminder will go out to the #all-hands channel. Congratulations team! :tada:
